queue.title: U.S. to tariff Chinese trailers to aid domestic producers
queue.excerpt: The Commerce Department is imposing tariffs of about 260% on “van-type trailers” were being “dumped” into the U.S. — imported at ultra cheap prices that make it difficult for domestic manufacturers to compete.

queue.title: CSX sees rail conversion opportunities from battered trucking market
queue.excerpt: The railroad is reviewing shipper truckload files to provide service and cost comparisons for intermodal opportunities.
